children.name: body
children.characters:
Grant is a strong and inspiring 11-year-old who is bravely battling leukemia. This tournament is more than a game — it’s a way to come together and rally around Grant and his family.

By becoming a sponsor, you are helping provide hope, strength, and support when it’s needed most.

children.name: p
children.characters:
Become a sponsor or play as a foursome
every registration helps drive out leukemia, one swing at a time.

children.name: p
children.characters: If a sponsorship isn’t possible, please consider donating products, services, or gift certificates for our golf goodie bags, raffle, or silent auction. If you’d like to contribute to the event, please contact Jessica. Otherwise, please consider donating to Grant’s GoFundMe. This event wouldn’t be possible without the generous support of our donors — your contribution makes a huge difference.

children.name: Three lockups. children.name: Three variants across two sizes and five states. Every value is a bound variable — fills, strokes, padding, height, radius and gap. Rows are Variant × Size; columns are State.

children.name: The primary CTA fills with accent/default #CD4628, not the hot accent/display #F05323. The display orange is 3.16:1 — it passes as large display text and fails on a button. This is the one place the brand’s brightest colour is deliberately held back.

children.name: All eight tournament tiers are capped — Max 2, Max 9, Max 1, Max 5 — so availability is a first-class state, not a nicety. Without it the form keeps taking orders for a hole that is already gone.

104:3.name: Carousel
104:3.description:
Image rotator for last year’s tournament. Active slide flanked by dimmed peeks so the run reads as a sequence rather than three separate cards.

Slides are a fixed 3:2 landscape frame with the image set to FILL. The source set is mixed — 20 landscape 3:2, 5 landscape 4:3, 4 portrait 3:4 — so portraits centre-crop. Check those four before launch; a portrait of a person can lose heads to a landscape crop.

29 images is too many for dot indicators, so the counter carries position instead.

33:3.name: Footer
33:3.description: Three sections split by vertical orange rules. Orange works here because a rule is a graphic, not text — no orange in the palette clears 3:1 as text on the brand green. The mark is deliberately absent: it is the hero on Home and sits in the subpage nav, so a third appearance on one screen would dilute it.

32:14.name: Argyle Band
32:14.description: One diamond lattice in alternating greens, plus an identical lattice offset half a diamond drawn as a dotted orange outline — rebuilt from Diamond.svg as repeating geometry rather than fixed artwork. Trim has no crosshatch by design: below a 48px band the dots fall under 1px and read as mud. Header and footer only; the flyer uses it exactly twice and that restraint is why it reads as structure.

31:536.name: Nav
31:536.description: Registration is not a link — it is the orange Register Today button, sitting in the nav row beside the other destinations. Home shows no active state because Home is not one of the three destinations; subpages carry the orange active rule.

31:294.name: Logo
31:294.description: Badge carries its own cream shield for light grounds. White is the same mark without the shield, for white or cream. Negative is white + orange only, for the dark green nav. Never set the wordmark as type — the script, flag and awareness ribbon are drawn into the mark.

16:53.name: Button
16:53.description:
Primary CTA fills with accent/default #CD4628 — 4.66:1 with white at any size. accent/display #F05323 is NEVER a button fill: at 3.52:1 it only passes as large display text.

HOVER: fill moves to accent/hover (rust) AND the button lifts 2px — transform: translateY(-2px), 160ms ease-out. The lift is the dynamic cue; there is no shadow, because the flyer has none. Figma shows the colour change on hover via a prototype interaction; the lift is a CSS behaviour and lives in motion/lift.
PRESS: lift returns to 0 and the button scales to 0.98.

30:21.name: Nav Link
30:21.description: Hover on a destination IS the orange underline — 2px accent/display, wired as a live ON_HOVER interaction. Active is the same orange at 4px plus brighter text, so the current page still outranks whatever is being hovered. Orange is 2.48:1 on green and can never be the sole signal; text brightness and rule weight carry it.

35:304.name: Social Icon
35:304.description: Supplied marks, recoloured to text/inverse for the green footer. Rebind the fill for use on light grounds.

56:99.name: Tier Row
56:99.description: Full-width sponsor option. Rows replace the card grid because tiers carry between 2 and 6 benefits — as cards that produced wildly ragged heights, and as rows the variation is invisible. Detail on the left, price and action on the right. The row is not a link; Register Now is the only click target.

55:18.name: Badge
55:18.description: Availability cap on a sponsor tier. Reversed=True is for the dark green card: Neutral flips to a cream chip with green text, Limited to a solid orange chip with white text, SoldOut to a cream outline. On the light card the tones stay tinted.

22:99.name: Form Field
22:99.description:
Field borders use border/control — green at 64%, solved to 3:1 against bg/panel per WCAG 1.4.11. The soft decorative border/default is 1.37:1 and would make the field edge effectively invisible. Error uses state/limited (rust), which is the only orange that passes as small text.

Input surface is bg/field (white) so the box reads on both the page ground and a cream card.

51:257.name: Sponsor Tier Card
51:257.description:
Light by default, dark green on hover, and permanently dark for the Featured tier so the row always has an anchor and never reads as a uniform stack.

The card is NOT a link. Register Now is the only click target — a link wrapping a button is nested interactive content, and the usual workaround (stretching the button over the card) makes the button hover fire everywhere, which is exactly the nested state we want to keep. Card hover is presentation; the button is the action.

Register Now carries the selected tier into the form and the confirmation pane repeats it.

20:11.name: Badge
20:11.description: Sponsor tier availability. SoldOut is deliberately neutral — it reads as closed, not as an error. Limited uses rust (state/limited), the only orange safe at small text sizes.

24:67.name: Pairing Group
24:67.description: Read on a phone, outdoors, in sunlight, looking for your own name. Card is the mobile default — no horizontal scrolling, 44px minimum touch rows, black on cream for glare. Highlighted is the find-my-name state. Pending covers the weeks before pairings are published.

1:90.name: display/xl
1:90.description: Hero wordmark support. The wordmark itself is the vector logo, never type.

1:92.name: display/italic
1:92.description: The "TEEING OFF" treatment. Set in caps.

1:100.name: label/md
1:100.description: Uppercase micro-labels. Apply text-transform in code.

1:101.name: label/price
1:101.description: Sponsor tier price. Tabular figures in code.

name: Teeing Off Fore Grant — Design System
